review_description: Matt and the team have just installed our new Solar System.As well as being highly skilled electricians they were friendly, on time, and worked efficiently.They also cleaned up all the leaf litter from our roof which was a bonus.We are very happy with our new solar panels.

Look no further!!! Matt from Curran-T Electrical & Solar and his team installed our new solar system at our house on the central coast. They did an amazing job. Right from the start I could not fault their experience, from the initial time we met to the after sales service. Matt was prompt and efficient and Matt and his team did a great job tiding up after themselves. Matt went through our current energy requirements and asked about our vehicles which I wasn’t expecting. He explained that this was needed to design the right system for our needs now and into the future. We now have a sub board and inverter in our garage which we can easily add a battery and EV charger to when we get our new car. We couldn’t be happier with Matt and his team and will be using CES (Curran-T Electrical & Solar) for our upcoming renovations. All in all great advice and great to deal with. Our Solar system is working great, thank you to the CES team.
